create_DetectionsSmoother: create a DetectionsSmoother instance with configurable history length for video tracking
update_with_detections: update the smoother with new detections and return smoothed results across frames
get_track: get the smoothed detection for a specific track ID averaged over its history
get_smoothed_detections: get all smoothed detections merged from every tracked object's history
build_video_tracking_pipeline: build a video tracking pipeline using DetectionsSmoother with ByteTrack and YOLO
